cases.stimulus: Perform20 sequential ordinary connection/query/disconnect attempts while their owned backend tails remain active, recording actual PG slot rejection; then attempt3 context registrations and observer cleanup. Freeze exact query/barrier driver before run. Repeat observer loss during exhaustion as a separate fixture.
cases.pass_predicate: Live-handler caps remain respected but actual backend count is measured rather than inferred. PG slot exhaustion yields bounded context UNAVAILABLE and retained CONNECTING/UNKNOWN whenever backend identity is uncertain. Persistent observer is not silently replaced; no extra observer reservation, broad kill or manual state deletion. No advertised guarantee of17 aggregate backends or always-available context slot.

Any SQL bypass or foreign signal
